case: Human approval routing for an unparseable MySQL routine
contract: A real guarded MySQL session classifies CREATE PROCEDURE bookie_unparseable_approval() SELECT 1 as Unparseable and routes the approval request to the human sink with the connection identity and original SQL.
Deny returns PolicyDenied and information_schema.routines confirms the procedure was not dispatched.
AllowOnce routes a second request through the human sink and creates the procedure; the agent sink is never called.
The GTK dialog's visible class/SQL presentation remains separately covered by the existing GTK safety scenario using SQLite.
